title: WCL Mining Sirdar Mock Test 05
subtitle: Western Coalfields Limited — Mining Sirdar Recruitment
instructions: Select the best answer for each question

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The 'settling of stowing material' in goaf occurs because
options: Because the stowing is done only on the surface
Because the sand used is very light in weight
Water drains away and material settles under gravity
Because the settling of the stowing material stops immediately
questions.solution: Material settles as water drains and gravity acts.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The minimum percentage of incombustible content required in roadways to prevent coal dust explosion propagation is
questions.solution: Minimum 65% incombustible content is required.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: Stowing is particularly important in
options: Open cast mines working on the thick seams of the coal only
Underground mines near surface structures or water bodies
Mines that have no mined-out goaf area at all
Mines working on thin seams and shallow depths
questions.solution: Underground mines near surface structures or water bodies.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The 'drift dimensions' are determined by
options: The personal whim of the mine manager working on his night shift
The intended use, equipment size, and ventilation requirements
Only the number of workers employed in that section
The season of the year in the coal mining region
questions.solution: Intended use, equipment size, and ventilation requirements.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The upper explosive limit of coal dust in air is approximately
options: 500 g/m³
questions.solution: The upper explosive limit is approximately 2000 g/m³.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The 'ventilation resistance' in mine airways is affected by
options: The colour of the roadway lining
Regulate the air temperature of the mine workings
Airway dimensions, roughness, and length
The depth of the winding shaft only
questions.solution: Ventilation resistance depends on dimensions, roughness, length.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The 'backfill' method of stowing involves
options: Blowing the compressed air into the mined-out goaf at the face
Placing waste material directly into the mined-out area
Spreading the stowing sand on the surface depot
Filling the underground mine sump with sand
questions.solution: Placing waste directly into mined-out area.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: A longwall face equipment includes
options: Shearer, AFC, powered supports, and stage loader
Shovel, dumper, and dragline used on the mine surface
The surface miner and a conveyor system
The rope shovel and the steam wagon drill
questions.solution: Includes shearer, AFC, powered supports, and stage loader.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The 'haul road maintenance' includes
options: Regular grading, watering, and berm maintenance
Painting the road signs and the berms only
No maintenance of any kind is needed
Washing the mine dumpers used on the haul road only
questions.solution: Road maintenance includes grading, watering, and berm maintenance.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The 'inspection book' in a mine must be kept at
options: Underground at the face of the working in the section
With the winding engineman working at the bottom of the main mine shaft
In the surface office cabin of the mine manager here
A convenient place near the main entrance for inspection by workers
questions.solution: A convenient place near the main entrance.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: Under the Mines Act 1952, notice of which of the following accidents is required to be given to the prescribed authorities?
options: Loss of life, serious bodily injury, explosion, ignition, fire, inrush of water or other matter
Injury or damage to any machinery, plant or equipment used in the mine workings
The falling of roof or of the ribs in any underground mine working place or section of the workings
The breakdown of any equipment or machinery used underground in the mine
questions.solution: Mines Act 1952, s.23: notice is required for loss of life, serious injury, and specified occurrences such as explosion, ignition, fire, inrush of water.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: Before each shift, the winding engine must be
options: Left as it is without inspection
Checked by the pumpman working at the sump
Examined and tested by the operator
Examined by the banksman only
questions.solution: Examined and tested by the operator before each shift.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: Stone dust barriers must be examined
options: Only once in every five years of service
At regular intervals to ensure effectiveness
Only once in every calendar year of operation
Only once in every ten years of operation
questions.solution: Regular examination to ensure effectiveness is required.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: A 'drift' driven at an angle to the horizontal is called
options: A vertical shaft
A horizontal tunnel
A crosscut only
A raise or an incline
questions.solution: A raise or an incline.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The 'stowing face' must be
options: Kept in the mined-out area without any support
Properly ventilated and maintained safe for workers
A place in the mine without ventilation
Kept closed to inspection by the mine officials of the area
questions.solution: Properly ventilated and maintained safe.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The 'annual returns' under the Mines Act must be submitted by
options: The manager to the inspector of mines
The workers' union of the mine
The mine owner or the owner of the mine
The local police station of the area
questions.solution: The manager to the inspector of mines.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The 'VOD' of an explosive stands for
options: Velocity of Detonation
Value of Detonation
Volume of Detonation
Voltage of Detonation
questions.solution: VOD is Velocity of Detonation - the speed at which detonation wave travels.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: Personal Protective Equipment (PPE) in mines includes
options: Helmet, safety lamp, self-rescuer, safety shoes, and protective clothing
The electrical distance protection of the mine equipment
The overcurrent protection of the cables and of the switchgear installed there
A cloth cap or a turban worn in place of a safety helmet
questions.solution: Multiple PPE items are required.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: Who is the first line of safety in a mine?
options: Shot firer
Surveyor
Manager
Sirdar
questions.solution: The sirdar is the first line of safety in a mine.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The main earthing system in a mine connects
options: All exposed metal parts of electrical equipment to earth
Only the star connected equipment in the mine
The cores of the trailing power cables that are used underground
The frame and the casing of the main fan motor
questions.solution: All exposed metal parts to earth.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The 'scale' of a mine plan indicates
options: The weight of the drawing sheet used
The physical size of the plan sheet
Ratio of plan distance to actual distance
The colour of the lines drawn on the plan sheet
questions.solution: Scale indicates ratio of plan distance to actual distance.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The most common cause of fatal accidents in underground coal mines is
options: Drowning
Fire
Roof fall
Gas explosion
questions.solution: Roof fall is the most common cause of fatal accidents.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The 'stowing dam material' typically includes
options: Concrete, steel, and timber depending on conditions
The river gravel and the coarse mine sand
The crushed bricks and the stone rubble
The garden soil and the top soil taken away from the surface
questions.solution: Dam materials include concrete, steel, and timber.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The 'pressure cell' in mining monitors
options: The fluid pressure in the borehole
The water pressure in the workings
Ground pressure and stress distribution
The ventilation pressure of the district
questions.solution: Pressure cells monitor ground pressure and stress distribution.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: A circuit breaker in a mine is used to
options: The voltage regulation of the supply only
Automatically break the circuit in case of fault
The transient response testing of relays
To amplify the current that is used in the mine circuit
questions.solution: Automatically breaks the circuit in case of fault.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: When two or more man riding systems operate on the same route, they must have
options: No special signaling arrangement at all
An identical speed of operation of the mine cars
Proper signaling and coordination arrangements
A single common driver for the cars
questions.solution: Proper signaling and coordination arrangements are required.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The stone dust barrier works by
options: Blocking the airflow through the roadway
Releasing inert material to suppress the explosion
Absorbing the water and the moisture present
Preventing the spread of the firedamp along the road
questions.solution: Releases inert material to suppress the explosion.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The fire-fighting equipment in a mine must include
options: A single bucket of dry sand kept at the pit top of the mine site
Nothing specific for the class or grade of mine
A fire ladder kept at the entrance of the mine
Fire extinguishers, sand buckets, hose pipes, and water supply
questions.solution: Fire extinguishers, sand buckets, hose pipes, and water supply.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The 'support design' for underground mines must consider
options: Only the prevention of water ingress into the workings
The colour of the overlying and the coal strata
Geology, depth, mining method, and loading conditions
The protection of the electrical equipment
questions.solution: Support design considers geology, depth, method, and loading.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The 'inundation warning signs' include
options: A sudden rise in the temperature of the air
No warning signs of any kind at all need ever to be given
Sudden increase in water inflow, changes in water color
A change in the direction of the air current
questions.solution: Warning signs include increased inflow and color changes.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: A belt conveyor must have
options: A guard rail fixed along the moving belt run of the conveyor
No safety device of any kind fitted on the belt
A signal bell fitted near the conveyor drive end
Pull cord switches, belt drift switches, and speed switches
questions.solution: Pull cord switches, belt drift switches, and speed switches.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The 'registers' that must be maintained in a mine include
options: The register kept for the staff of the mine canteen and colony services
Attendance, accident, inspection, and other prescribed registers
The visitor book kept at the main entrance of the mine
The personal diary kept by the mine manager on site
questions.solution: Attendance, accident, inspection, and other prescribed registers.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: Under CMR 2017, the 'record of safety inspections' must be maintained by
options: The manager for a period of at least 2 years
The safety officer of the mine for a period of two years
The inspector of mines for five years
The mine manager for one year only
questions.solution: The manager for at least 2 years.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: A dust explosion requires the presence of
options: The coal dust that is finely suspended in the air
The roof bolts and the wooden props
Dust, oxygen, ignition source, and confinement
A continuous miner working the seam
questions.solution: All four elements are required.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The 'drift signage' must include
options: The name and the logo of the operating mine company itself
Directional signs, safety warnings, and distance markers
No signage of any kind at all is ever required
Only the telephone number of the mine office
questions.solution: Drift signage includes directions, warnings, distance markers.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The frequency of electrical maintenance in mines is determined by
options: The wishes of the workers' union of the mine workers
The advice of the equipment suppliers
The manager based on conditions and regulations
The advice of the mine security staff
questions.solution: The manager based on conditions and regulations.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The 'intake air' in mine ventilation is
options: The exhausted air from the workings
The recirculated air of the district
The contaminated air of the return
Fresh air entering the mine
questions.solution: Intake air is fresh air entering the mine.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The 'shot hole' in underground coal mines is drilled at
options: Predetermined angle and depth as per blast design
Any convenient angle and depth of hole
A vertical hole that is always drilled in the working face
A horizontal hole across the main roadway
questions.solution: Shot holes are drilled at predetermined angles and depths.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The 'man-riding and haulage' arrangements must be
options: Left to the operator's choice
Any arrangement of the persons carried at all
Safe, efficient, and as per regulations
The same arrangement for every mine
questions.solution: Safe, efficient, and as per regulations.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The total dust in mines consists of
options: The fraction retained in the ribs and roof
The fraction deposited on the roadway floor
Only the fraction visible to the naked eye
Respirable and non-respirable fractions
questions.solution: Total dust consists of respirable and non-respirable fractions.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The 'breasting' method of working involves
options: Extracting coal from the face in a horizontal direction
The sinking of a new shaft from the surface
The boring of a borehole through the seam
The dumping of the waste material in the mined-out goaf
questions.solution: Extracting coal horizontally from the face.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The main difficulty of hydraulic stowing in steep seams is
options: The very high cost of the stowing sand that is used
The stowing pipes are too long to lay
Gravity causes uneven distribution of material
No suitable stowing sand is available
questions.solution: Gravity causes uneven distribution.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The 'gateway' or 'gate road' in longwall mining provides
options: A separate ventilation shaft to the surface
Access, ventilation, and transport to the longwall face
A cross-cut driven between two adjacent longwall panels
A stope that is worked outbye the gate road
questions.solution: Access, ventilation, and transport to face.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The 'face ventilation' in underground mines is designed to
options: Dilute and remove gases and dust from the working face
To increase the temperature of the mine air
To reduce the humidity of the mine workings
To cool the whole mine and all of the underground workings
questions.solution: Face ventilation dilutes and removes gases and dust from working areas.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The 'incubation period' of coal refers to
options: The time taken for the mine to reach its full capacity
The period during which water is drained from a seam
The time from first exposure of coal to air until spontaneous ignition
The interval between two statutory examinations of the mine
questions.solution: Time from first exposure to air until spontaneous ignition.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The 'explosive' used in drifting must be
options: The explosive is used for the roof support operations in the mine
The explosive is used for charging the detonators in the hole
Any blasting gelatine of any make, brand or strength at all
As permitted for the conditions - permissible explosives in gassy mines
questions.solution: As permitted for the conditions.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The 'crib' support in mining consists of
options: A single steel prop fitted with a steel cap
Interlocked timber or steel members forming a stack
A single vertical column of timber in the roof
Concrete blocks laid in the courses of work
questions.solution: Cribs are interlocked timber or steel stacks for support.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The time of commencement and completion of work in a district is required to be recorded by the sirdar in
options: The attendance register of the mine
The personal diary of the mine manager
A bound paged report book kept for the purpose
The register kept for the shot firing
questions.solution: The sirdar is required to record the time of commencement and completion of work in the report book kept for the purpose.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: An 'environmental monitoring report' includes
options: The personal opinions of the officer making the report
Only the number of workers employed in the mine district
Dust levels, gas concentrations, temperature, and humidity readings
The use of very informal and casual spoken language in it
questions.solution: Dust levels, gas concentrations, temperature, and humidity.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The 'ventilation' of drifts is required to
options: Only for the use of the mine officers
To increase the temperature of the mine air
Provide fresh air and remove contaminants
To provide the light in the workings
questions.solution: Drift ventilation provides fresh air and removes contaminants.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: A 'rise' in mining is a drift driven
options: Vertically only
Horizontally
Upward from a lower level
Downward from surface
questions.solution: A rise is a drift driven upward from a lower level.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The maximum speed of a winding engine depends on
options: The time of the day when the shift is worked
The weather at the surface of the mine
The personal wish of the winding operator
The design and safe working load of the system
questions.solution: Depends on design and safe working load.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: DGMS circulars are
options: Mandatory instructions for compliance in mines
Advisory only for the large mines of the country
Non-statutory guidelines for the mines
Applicable only to the metal and mineral mines
questions.solution: Mandatory instructions for compliance in mines.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The 'purpose' of a report should be stated
options: Skip the executive summary entirely
Only at the end of the report
Clearly at the beginning of the report
Only in the appendix of the report
questions.solution: Clearly at the beginning of the report.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: A man riding system must be tested for
options: Only when the man riding system is new
Only once in every five years of operation
Only when the operator of the mine demands
Load capacity and safety before carrying passengers
questions.solution: Load capacity and safety before carrying passengers.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The 'bolt pattern' in roof support is determined by
options: Only the control of the dust emissions
Only the prevention of water ingress
Roof conditions, span, and loading requirements
A uniform bolt pattern for all mines
questions.solution: Bolt patterns are determined by conditions, span, and loading.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The sirdar must ensure that the working place is freed from
options: Loose rib or roof material at the face
Water accumulated in the roadway sump
Any danger before allowing persons to work
Untested shot holes left at the face
questions.solution: The working place must be freed from any danger.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The language of an official report should be
options: Flowery, decorative and ornate in style
Argumentative and defensive in its tone
Personal, anecdotal and highly informal
Formal, objective, and free from personal opinions
questions.solution: Formal, objective, and free from personal opinions.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The 'floor heave' in coal mines can be caused by
options: Highly compacted and strong roof strata
The strong sandstone floor strata of the seam
The dry conditions throughout the working year
Weak floor strata, water ingress, and stress
questions.solution: Floor heave is caused by weak strata, water, and stress.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The 'carbon monoxide' (CO) in mines is dangerous because
options: It is toxic and can cause death even at low concentrations
It only causes drowsiness to the persons working
It is much heavier than the air of the workings
It is beneficial for the breathing of the miners
questions.solution: CO is toxic and can cause death at low concentrations.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The 'levelling instrument' in mine surveying is used to determine
options: The horizontal angle between two points
Difference in elevation between points
To test the stability of the roof
The bearing of a traverse line
questions.solution: Determines difference in elevation between points.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: Drifting through fault zones requires
options: Special support and investigation measures
The ordinary timber supports of the mine
No special precautions of any kind
Only a warning sign at the fault
questions.solution: Fault zones require special support and investigation.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The 'inundation escape routes' in mines must be
options: Used only during the day shifts of the mine
Clearly marked and accessible at all times
Locked during the working hours of the shift
No escape routes of any kind needed
questions.solution: Escape routes must be marked and accessible at all times.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: Under CMR 2017, the 'explosive store' must be located
options: At the pit bottom close to the active mine workings
At a safe distance from the mine and other structures as prescribed
Very near to the mine canteen and the surface offices
Used mainly for the support of the roof of the mine
questions.solution: At a safe distance as prescribed.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The 'material classification' for blasting considers
options: Rock strength, density, fracturing characteristics
The colour of the rock after it is blasted
The cost of the drilling machine used in the mine
The time of firing of the shot in the round
questions.solution: Material classification considers strength, density, and fracturing.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: An electrical switchgear room must be
options: A separate ventilated room outside the mine on the surface site
A damp and dirty room kept near the underground water sump area
Properly ventilated, fire-resistant, and accessible only to authorized persons
A small temporary wooden shed located in the open coal stockyard
questions.solution: Properly ventilated, fire-resistant, and accessible to authorized persons.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: A 'conveyor system' is preferred when
options: Distance is long and material volume is high
Only when the distance to be covered is short
The terrain of the route is very steep
The material to be handled is explosive
questions.solution: Conveyors are preferred for long distances with high volumes.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: A mine fire can be classified as
options: Fires originating in electrical equipment
Fires of spontaneous origin belowground
Fires in surface buildings and workshops
Surface fire and underground fire
questions.solution: Surface fire and underground fire.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The 'chain pillar' in longwall mining is the
options: The roadway left between two longwalls
A temporary prop left after recovery
The pillar recovered during depillaring
Pillar between two adjacent longwall panels
questions.solution: Pillar between two adjacent panels.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: A 'ventilation deficiency report' should mention
options: Only the personal opinion of the mine manager on that shift
The attendance record of the mine shift workers present
The list of all the mine officials present in the ventilation district
Location, nature of deficiency, gas levels, and immediate action taken
questions.solution: Location, deficiency, gas levels, and immediate action.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The means of communication between different parts of a mine must be
options: Maintained in good working order
Installed only at the surface
Tested once every five years
Optional in developed mines
questions.solution: Effective means of communication must be maintained in good working order between different parts of a mine to ensure safety.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The 'grouting' method in stowing involves
options: The drying of the stowing sand in the sun
Nothing specific to the stowing method
Injecting cementitious material into voids
The filling of the voids with the mine air
questions.solution: Injecting cementitious material into voids.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: A 'haul cycle' includes
options: The loading of the coal at the working face
Hauling of waste to the spoil dump
Loading, hauling, dumping, returning empty
Only the tipping of material at the surface dump
questions.solution: Haul cycle includes load, haul, dump, return.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The stone dust used for stone dusting must contain
options: At least fifty per cent of calcium carbonate in the dust
At least twenty per cent of calcium carbonate in the dust
Just fifty per cent of calcium carbonate and nothing more
At least 80% calcium carbonate or equivalent incombustible material
questions.solution: At least 80% calcium carbonate or equivalent incombustible material.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The capacity of a SDL is typically
options: 2-4 tonnes per trip
20 tonnes
1 tonne
10 tonnes
questions.solution: Typically 2-4 tonnes per trip.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The 'barrier pillar' between workings and water bodies serves to
options: To provide the drainage of the mine water
To provide the ventilation to the workings
To increase the extraction of the seam
Prevent water ingress into active workings
questions.solution: Barrier pillars prevent water ingress from water bodies.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The maximum working hours in a week for an adult employed belowground in a mine are:
options: 54 hours
60 hours
45 hours
48 hours
questions.solution: Mines Act 1952, s.28: no person shall be employed belowground for more than 48 hours in any week.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The 'coal dust explosion' requires
options: The roof bolts and the timber props
A continuous miner cutting the seam
Coal dust, ignition source, and confined space
An open fire burning at the surface
questions.solution: Coal dust explosions need dust, ignition, and confinement.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The protection against electric shock includes
options: Only the differential protection of the circuit
Earthing, insulation, RCDs, and safe working practices
Only the overcurrent protection of the cables
Only the earth fault protection of the cables
questions.solution: Earthing, insulation, RCDs, and safe working practices.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The 'roof condition survey' in underground mines involves
options: The measurement of the width of the main haulage roadway
The setting out of the gate road centre line only
Systematic assessment of roof conditions and support adequacy
Only a visual check at the end of every mine shift
questions.solution: Roof condition surveys systematically assess conditions and support.

questions.subject: General
questions.stem: The 'Startup India' initiative supports
options: To support the conveyor belts in the mine
To promote the import of coal into India
Entrepreneurship and innovation across sectors
To control the dust emissions in the mine
questions.solution: Entrepreneurship and innovation.

questions.subject: General
questions.stem: The Indian Premier League (IPL) is associated with which sport?
options: Hockey
Tennis
Football
Cricket
questions.solution: IPL is a professional Twenty20 cricket league.

questions.subject: General
questions.stem: The 'Raniganj' coalfield is historically significant because
options: It was the first coal mining area in India
The only coalfield in eastern India
It holds the deepest coal seams of India
It has the largest coal washery of India
questions.solution: Raniganj was the first coal mining area in India.

questions.subject: General
questions.stem: The Indian national anthem 'Jana Gana Mana' was written by
options: Sarojini Naidu
Rabindranath Tagore
Bankim Chandra Chatterjee
Muhammad Iqbal
questions.solution: Written by Rabindranath Tagore.

questions.subject: General
questions.stem: The HCF of 18 and 24 is
questions.solution: HCF of 18 and 24 is 6.

questions.subject: General
questions.stem: The 'blending of imported coal' with domestic coal is done to
options: To increase the moisture content of the coal
Improve quality and reduce ash content for specific users
To reduce the freight cost paid per tonne of coal
To avoid the need for washing the imported coal
questions.solution: Improve quality and reduce ash content.

questions.subject: General
questions.stem: The 'coal gasification' technology converts coal into
options: Refined petroleum and diesel fuel directly
Synthesis gas (syngas) for various applications
Only the liquid fuel for the vehicles
Coke for the use in a blast furnace
questions.solution: Coal gasification converts coal into synthesis gas.

questions.subject: General
questions.stem: A bar chart shows accidents: 2020=50, 2021=45, 2022=40, 2023=35. What is the trend?
options: Constant
Fluctuating
Increasing
Decreasing
questions.solution: Accidents are decreasing.

questions.subject: General
questions.stem: Which country is 'Land of Rising Sun'?
options: Korea
Japan
Thailand
China
questions.solution: Japan is Land of the Rising Sun.

questions.subject: General
questions.stem: India's first 'Make in India' aircraft carrier was commissioned in
questions.solution: INS Vikrant was commissioned in 2022.

questions.subject: General
questions.stem: The 'Make in India' initiative in coal sector promotes
options: The import of all the mining machinery
Import of skilled contract labour
The import of all the mining equipment
Indigenous manufacturing of mining equipment
questions.solution: Indigenous manufacturing of mining equipment.

questions.subject: General
questions.stem: The 'technology adoption' in Indian coal mining has increased through
options: The subsidies paid on the imported equipment
Equipment imports, indigenous manufacturing, and R&D
A decline in the output per man shift of the mine
The replacement of all the manual methods of work
questions.solution: Equipment imports, indigenous manufacturing, and R&D.

questions.subject: General
questions.stem: The 'goaf' in underground mining is the
options: The space kept open for ventilation purposes
The area from which coal has been extracted
The unexcavated seam left between two workings
The roadway kept open for persons to travel
questions.solution: Area from which coal has been extracted.

questions.subject: General
questions.solution: Fibonacci: 5+8=13.

questions.subject: General
questions.stem: SI on ₹5,000 at 8% for 3 years?

questions.subject: General
questions.stem: The volume of a cube with side 5 cm is
options: 125 cm³
25 cm³
50 cm³
100 cm³
questions.solution: Volume = 5³ = 125 cm³.

questions.subject: General
questions.stem: Western Coalfields Limited (WCL) operates primarily in
options: The states of Bihar and Jharkhand only
Andhra Pradesh and Telangana
The states of Odisha and West Bengal
Maharashtra and Madhya Pradesh
questions.solution: WCL operates primarily in Maharashtra and Madhya Pradesh.

questions.subject: General
questions.stem: The 'mine reclamation bond' ensures
options: A one time registration charge for the mine
A share of the annual profit to the mine workers
A tax levied on the coal production of the mine
Funds for environmental restoration after mine closure
questions.solution: Funds for restoration after closure.

questions.subject: General
questions.stem: A line graph shows production: 2020=500, 2021=550, 2022=600, 2023=650. What is the annual growth rate?

questions.subject: General
questions.stem: The 'PM Gati Shakti' scheme aims to
options: Only the construction of the roads and highways
Integrated planning of multi-modal infrastructure
Only the development of the ports and harbours
A scheme only for the coal miners of India
questions.solution: Integrated multi-modal infrastructure planning.
